name: 0d3sa
description: Production Call Sheet design system for the Agentic Team Protocol docs and site.
north_star: The site is a working production call sheet for ATP. Every entry surface leads with the install/setup path, followed by roles, lifecycle lanes, and component reference. Dark board ground, panel fills, hairline borders, alert coral for primary actions, action blue for links, status chips with colored dots.

colors.name: panel-raised
colors.usage: code blocks, inputs, buttons, raised surfaces

tokens.css: :root { --board: #0d1117; --panel: #161b22; --panel-raised: #21262d; --border: #30363d; --border-subtle: #21262d; --text: #c9d1d9; --text-muted: #8b949e; --text-dim: #6e7681; --alert: #f78166; --alert-high: #ff9a80; --alert-soft: rgba(247, 129, 102, 0.12); --action: #58a6ff; --action-high: #79b8ff; --action-soft: rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.12); --ready: #3fb950; --ready-soft: rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.12); --ready-border-soft: rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.25); --restricted: #d29922; --restricted-soft: rgba(210, 153, 34, 0.12); --restricted-border-soft: rgba(210, 153, 34, 0.25); --blocked: #f85149; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-pill: 999px; --max: 1100px; --display: Chakra Petch, Saira, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; --body: Saira, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; --mono: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; }

button-primary.notes: Main call-to-action. Alert coral on dark board text. No border.

button-secondary.snippet: .btn.btn-secondary { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); } .btn.btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--action); color: var(--action); }
button-secondary.notes: Secondary action. Transparent with hairline border; hover turns action blue.

button-small.snippet: .btn.btn-sm { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.82rem; background: var(--panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); } .btn.btn-sm:hover { border-color: var(--alert); color: var(--alert); }

status-chip-ready.snippet: .status-chip.ready { background: var(--ready-soft); color: var(--ready); border: 1px solid var(--ready-border-soft); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
status-chip-ready.notes: Use for ready / active / success states. Always include a colored dot.

status-chip-restricted.snippet: .status-chip.restricted { background: var(--restricted-soft); color: var(--restricted); border: 1px solid var(--restricted-border-soft); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
status-chip-restricted.notes: Use for gated or charter-dependent states.

card.snippet: .card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 18px; min-width: 0; }
card.notes: Flat panel surface with 1px border and 12px radius. No shadows.

block-label.snippet: .block-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }

command-block.snippet: .cmd { display: block; background: var(--board); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 10px 12px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text); overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; max-width: 100%; }
command-block.notes: Copyable shell command in the call sheet. Wraps if too long.

copy-button.snippet: .copy-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-muted); } .copy-btn:hover { border-color: var(--alert); color: var(--alert); }
copy-button.notes: Icon-only button next to a command block.

site-header.snippet: .site-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--board); position: sticky; top: 0; height: 60px; }
site-header.notes: Sticky header with hairline bottom border.

brand-mark.snippet: .brand-mark { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--alert); color: var(--board); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; }
brand-mark.notes: Alert coral square badge containing the 0 mark.

component-tag.snippet: .component-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--action-soft); color: var(--action); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
component-tag.notes: Small pill tag above component card names.

sheet-foot.snippet: .sheet-foot { padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--alert-soft); border: 1px solid rgba(247, 129, 102, 0.2); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.88rem; }
sheet-foot.notes: Alert-tinted reminder strip below the install panel.

rules.name: One Alert Rule
rules.text: Alert coral is reserved for the primary action. Do not use it for decorative accents or secondary labels.

rules.name: Status Dot Rule
rules.text: Every status chip must carry a solid dot in its text color.

rules.name: Monospace Is For Commands Rule
rules.text: JetBrains Mono appears only for shell commands, paths, tool names, and production labels.

rules.name: No Shadow Rule
rules.text: Shadows are not used as decoration. Depth comes from tonal panel layers and hairline borders.

rules.name: No Gradient Or Glass Rule
rules.text: No gradients, glass, blur, or ornamental decoration.

rules.name: No Emoji Icon Rule
rules.text: Use inline SVG or simple shapes for icons, never emoji or Unicode glyphs.

rules.name: Hairline Rule
rules.text: All dividing lines are 1px. Increase space, not stroke weight, if separation feels weak.

rules.name: No Duplicate H1 Rule
rules.text: In Starlight docs, rely on frontmatter title; do not repeat it with a markdown # heading.

narrative: A dark production-board world for the 0d3sa docs site. The dominant element on entry surfaces is the install/setup steps panel: numbered steps with copyable commands, role roster badges, and seven-stage lifecycle lanes. Headings are Chakra Petch, body is Saira, commands are JetBrains Mono. Palette is near-black board (#0d1117), panel (#161b22), hairline borders (#30363d), alert coral (#f78166) for primary actions, action blue (#58a6ff) for links, ready green (#3fb950) and restricted amber (#d29922) for status chips. User-facing copy avoids film-production jargon; flat, shadowless, no gradients, no emoji.
